title: Space bounded by elapsed time
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x,y$ be Boolean words and $T$ a natural number. If $M$ computes $y$ from $x$ within $T$ steps, then for every natural number $t$, the total number of work-tape cells visited through step $t$ is at most $k(T+1)$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k$ work tapes
